COURSE CHECKNot a flat 20K: +1130 m on 22.8 km, with a 3.6 km climb at 14% average and a 500 m stretch near 33% around km 11. Mogan Shan is bamboo forest and stone steps: slippery when wet. Recheck the official course, cut-offs and mandatory kit once 2027 is published.

WHAT TO DO
WATCH OUT

Points are placed from the GPX profile, not surveyed on site. Never stop on a narrow trail or stone steps; step aside first.

Heart rates and paces are planning suggestions, not measured zones or medical limits. Go by breathing and effort; stop and get help for chest pain, dizziness or unusual breathlessness.

03Fuel by the clock, not by hunger

Race-day timeline · times from the start gun

  1. Night beforeCarb-rich dinner, lay out kitRice or noodles, nothing new. Fill flasks, pin the bib, charge watch and phone.
  2. Start −3 hBreakfast: 60–90 g carbse.g. two slices of toast + banana + honey, or a big bowl of oats. Not just a banana (lesson from Goleta 11/21).
  3. Start −30 min300–500 ml water, short warm-upThe first climb starts right away, so 5 minutes of easy jogging and a few leg swings are enough.
  4. 0:40Gel 1 (around km 4–5, second climb)Then every 40–45 min. Take each gel with a few mouthfuls of water.
  5. ~1:25Gel 2 at the foot of the big climb (km 8)Fuel before the wall, not on it. Drink ~500 ml per hour; more if warm.
  6. ~2:10Gel 3 on the ridge (km 12–13)Top of the course. Refill at the aid station if there is one here (check the official aid list).
  7. ~2:50Gel 4 at the start of the long descent (km 15)Fuel keeps your focus sharp on the stone steps. Carry one spare.
  8. 3–4 hFinish in DeqingWalk 10 minutes, eat and drink within 30 minutes.

04Trail kit

0 / 9

Mandatory kitUTMB races publish a mandatory kit list (often a phone, cup, jacket and survival blanket). The list here is a plan; follow the official 2027 list.

Practice everythingNothing new on race day: the shoes, vest, gels and breakfast must all have been used on long training runs.

PolesOptional. They help on the 14% climb, but only if you have trained with them; check the race rules.

Prep for this course

Climbing: the 50 m hill (南翠屏) works if you add reps: 6 → 16–20 (800–1000 m). Add 30–45 min continuous hiking on a 12–15% treadmill for the km 8–12 wall.

Descending: step-downs and single-leg squats twice a week; run the last reps of each hill session downhill at race effort. The final 8 km descent is where untrained quads fail.

Long runs: build from 12 km (flat, 水西公园) to 2.5–3 h on hills by early spring, with ~800 m+ of climbing.

Fuel: you have never used gels. Try one on each long run from now on, at 40 min, with water. Find a brand your stomach likes.

Pacing: your pattern is going out too fast while HR lags. On race day the first 3.5 km is a climb in a crowd, so walk the steep bits even if others run.

Gear: buy trail shoes now (wet roots and stone steps) and break them in on every hill session.

05Ask the coach

Data & limitations

Route source: The GPX you shared (Mogan_23k_1200_0911, 1388 points). It matches a ~23 km / ~1200 m course; whether it is the 2027 EMG 20K course is not confirmed.

Distance & ascent:

Real contours: From public Terrarium DEM tiles (zoom 13), 20 m interval, bold every 100 m. DEM smooths out stone steps and short walls, so real slopes are steeper in places.

Planning, not a promise: Paces assume your current road fitness (easy ~6:40–7:00/km at HR ~145) and typical trail slow-downs. Re-estimate after long hill runs in February–March.
